turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is there a way to read in bed without keeping my wife awake?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A small clip on reading light with a warm, dim bulb works well. Or an e-reader with a backlight you can turn way down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She says even turning pages bugs her.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then an e-reader is your friend, it's completely silent. Some people also switch to audiobooks with one earbud in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd fall asleep in two minutes with an audiobook.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most apps have a sleep timer, so it stops after fifteen or thirty minutes and you won't lose your place too badly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: try the timer thing tonight and see who falls asleep first.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good luck. My money's on you.
